background.title: Our Background
background.description: Founded in 2010, Huateng Group is a premium and professional study abroad education group headquartered in Shenzhen, with branches in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and other major cities. The group specializes in undergraduate and postgraduate study abroad applications, with particularly deep expertise and an outstanding reputation in Hong Kong bachelor's degree admissions. Over the past decade, Huateng Group has consistently upheld a student-centered service philosophy, helping over 10,000 students successfully enter the world's top universities, with acceptance rates consistently leading the industry.

vision.description: To become the world's leading study abroad education service group, building bridges to prestigious universities for students around the globe.

mission.description: To help every student achieve their dream of attending a prestigious university, providing the most professional and caring academic planning and application services.
